tool_calls.question: Hurricane impact data for Cameron County including hurricane strike rate, building exposure, and social vulnerability (SoVI) across all hexes. Include hexes with missing SoVI data and calculate coverage fraction.
tool_calls.output:
SQL: WITH county_hexes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT h.hex_id
    FROM hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk h
    WHERE h.County = 'Cameron County'
),
missing_sovi_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS missing_sovi_hexes
    FROM VUL_002 v
    JOIN county_hexes ch ON v.hex_id = ch.hex_id
    WHERE v.sovi = -999
),
coverage_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_hexes_in_county,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN v.sovi != -999 THEN 1 END) AS hexes_with_sovi_data,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN v.sovi = -999 THEN 1 END) AS hexes_missing_sovi_data
    FROM county_hexes ch
    LEFT JOIN VUL_002 v ON ch.hex_id = v.hex_id
)
SELECT
    (SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(hh.hurr_strike_rate_10y AS DOUBLE)), 3)
     FROM HP_HUR_001 hh
     JOIN county_hexes ch ON hh.hex_id = ch.hex_id) AS avg_hurricane_strike_rate_10y,
    (SELECT SUM(hh.hurr_strike_rate_10y)
     FROM HP_HUR_001 hh
     JOIN county_hexes ch ON hh.hex_id = ch.hex_id) AS total_hurricane_strikes_10y,
    (SELECT SUM(eb.building_count)
     FROM EX_BLD_001 eb
     JOIN county_hexes ch ON eb.hex_id = ch.hex_id) AS total_building_count,
    (SELECT ROUND(SUM(eb2.hEE), 2)
     FROM EX_BLD_002 eb2
     JOIN county_hexes ch ON eb2.hex_id = ch.hex_id) AS total_home_value_weighted_exposure_usd,
    (SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(v.sovi AS DOUBLE)), 4)
     FROM VUL_002 v
     JOIN county_hexes ch ON v.hex_id = ch.hex_id
     WHERE v.sovi != -999) AS avg_sovi_score,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM VUL_002 v
     JOIN county_hexes ch ON v.hex_id = ch.hex_id
     WHERE v.sovi != -999) AS hexes_with_valid_sovi,
    (SELECT missing_sovi_hexes FROM missing_sovi_count) AS hexes_missing_sovi_data,
    (SELECT
        ROUND(
            CAST(hexes_with_sovi_data AS DOUBLE) /
            NULLIF(CAST(total_hexes_in_county AS DOUBLE), 0),
            4
        )
     FROM coverage_stats) AS sovi_coverage_fraction,
    (SELECT total_hexes_in_county FROM coverage_stats) AS total_hexes_in_county

tool_calls.output:
SQL: WITH county_hexes AS (
    SELECT
        h.hex_id,
        h.hurr_strike_rate_10y,
        s.ve_ae_fraction,
        c.nri_cri_score
    FROM HP_HUR_001 h
    JOIN HP_HUR_002 s ON h.hex_id = s.hex_id
    JOIN CR_001 c ON h.hex_id = c.hex_id
    JOIN hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk x ON h.hex_id = x.hex_id
    WHERE x.County = 'Chambers County'
),
surge_threshold AS (
    SELECT
        QUANTILE_CONT(ve_ae_fraction, 0.75) AS high_surge_p75
    FROM HP_HUR_002 h2
    JOIN hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk x2 ON h2.hex_id = x2.hex_id
    WHERE x2.County = 'Chambers County'
),
resilience_threshold AS (
    SELECT
        QUANTILE_CONT(nri_cri_score, 0.25) AS low_resilience_p25
    FROM CR_001 c2
    JOIN hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk x2 ON c2.hex_id = x2.hex_id
    WHERE x2.County = 'Chambers County'
)
SELECT
    ch.hex_id,
    ch.hurr_strike_rate_10y,
    ROUND(ch.ve_ae_fraction, 3) AS ve_ae_fraction,
    ROUND(ch.nri_cri_score, 1) AS nri_cri_score,
    CASE
        WHEN ch.ve_ae_fraction > st.high_surge_p75
        THEN 'High Surge Exposure'
        ELSE 'Not High Surge'
    END AS surge_exposure_category,
    CASE
        WHEN ch.nri_cri_score < rt.low_resilience_p25
        THEN 'Low Resilience'
        ELSE 'Not Low Resilience'
    END AS resilience_category,
    CASE
        WHEN ch.ve_ae_fraction > st.high_surge_p75
           AND ch.nri_cri_score < rt.low_resilience_p25
        THEN 'High Priority'
        ELSE 'Not High Priority'
    END AS recovery_priority
FROM county_hexes ch
CROSS JOIN surge_threshold st
CROSS JOIN resilience_threshold rt
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN ch.ve_ae_fraction > st.high_surge_p75
           AND ch.nri_cri_score < rt.low_resilience_p25
        THEN 1
        ELSE 2
    END,
    ch.ve_ae_fraction DESC,
    ch.nri_cri_score ASC,
    ch.hex_id ASC;

tool_calls.output:
SQL: WITH county_aggregates AS (
    SELECT
        x.County,
        x.State,
        SUM(COALESCE(p.hifld_energy_plants_n, 0)) AS total_power_plants,
        SUM(COALESCE(s.hifld_energy_substations_n, 0)) AS total_substations,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.hifld_energy_plants_n, 0) > 0 THEN x.hex_id END) AS hexes_with_power_plants,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.hifld_energy_substations_n, 0) > 0 THEN x.hex_id END) AS hexes_with_substations
    FROM hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk x
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-PLANTS-N" p ON x.hex_id = p.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" s ON x.hex_id = s.hex_id
    GROUP BY x.County, x.State
)
SELECT
    County,
    State,
    total_power_plants,
    total_substations,
    hexes_with_power_plants,
    hexes_with_substations
FROM county_aggregates
WHERE total_power_plants > 0 OR total_substations > 0
